title: 主菜单
prompt:
Generate ONE final individual game UI PAGE, not contact sheet, no presentation sidebars, no multiple thumbnails. Premium Chinese PC Godot jungle tower defense UI. Strictly use reference1 approved moss jade board as MATERIAL, color and typography guide; reference2 actual screenshot as WORLD GEOMETRY and icon/character guide. Preserve existing low-poly gameplay world, grass stone paths blue robot, DO NOT replace with cinematic photoreal temple. UI framing realistic charcoal basalt, thin worn bronze edges, very sparse moss ONLY outer corners, restrained jade green active state and ivory clean readable Chinese labels. Clean flat dark panel interiors, balanced spacing, refined functionality, no huge decorative outer frame. Original 1080x768-ish screen proportions or 4:3, full screen screenshot style, high resolution. Retain game name 丛林塔防 exactly. NO invented pause buttons,1x2x speed controls,minimap,shop,skilltree,battlepass,save/continue. No unsupported hotkeys Y U I. Numbers are design samples. Important layout: battle skills LEFT, equipment and buffs CENTER, player talent RIGHT, selected unit strip ABOVE; never swap to generic MMO HUD. 
PAGE: 主菜单
Centered 丛林塔防 title, three vertical buttons 开始游戏 设置 退出游戏. Actual original grassy misty game scene backdrop, no cinematic new environment.
